smc.verdict: NO self-modifying code. Evidence: .text contains zero `cache` instructions, and the module imports no icache-maintenance function (its only cache imports are sceKernelDcacheWritebackAll/Range, which are data-side coherency for the GE and sceDmacMemcpy). The .text segment is also not writable on its own -- phdr[0] covers .text and .data together, so W is unavoidable there, but no icache invalidate means any write could never be executed. A fallback interpreter (plan §Phase 9.6) is therefore NOT required for this title.
